svg.title: Wider intervals can improve proper score
svg.desc: Changes relative to Condition CQR, with equal station weights. Positive width change means wider intervals; negative proper interval score change is better. No uncertainty bands are invented. Stratum-level worsening is retained in the accompanying article.
